## Aspects and tensions

civilian control of the military (constitutional design — who can order troop deployment, budget oversight), police accountability and judicial oversight, prohibition of party militias/private armies, coup-proofing, the tension between security-service secrecy and democratic transparency (parallel to the accountability/transparency principle).
